name: Qoder Mobile
desc: Phone app for controlling Qoder agents remotely
desc_zh: 在手机上远程查看和操控 Qoder 智能体的应用
solves: A long agent task used to chain you to the desk; check progress, approve actions and reply from your phone.
solves_zh: 长任务原来必须守在电脑前，现在在手机上就能看进度、批操作、回提问。
best_for: You stepped away while a migration ran and a permission prompt is waiting for you.
best_for_zh: 你离开工位时任务还在跑，手机上正好弹出一个等待审批的操作。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://docs.qoder.com/llms.txt (Mobile & Web), https://qoder.com/mobile; A ）。 Native iOS / Android / HarmonyOS app plus a web client (qoder.com/agents, titled 'Qoder Web') for Remote Control and cloud tasks. The form enum has no mobile value, so 'desktop' (native client) was used. Timeline: announced 2026-04-30 with the mobile apps 'Listing' in stores; the international iOS app first appeared in the App Store on 2026-05-13 (same date in sg/jp/hk storefronts; not listed in us/gb); the CN iOS app 'Qoder CN' (bundle com.qoder.app.cn, seller Hangzhou Yundian Technology) first appeared 2026-05-22. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.qoder.mobile; Harmony: appgallery id com.qoder.hmos.global. Its changelog only starts at 2026-11-10. Official family card: 'Mobile & Web — Remotely follow supported Qoder and CLI tasks, or use the documented cloud-task workflow.' 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里 Gemini app、Le Chat 这类手机应用记为 web，不记为 desktop。地区与账本里的 Qoder（IDE）保持一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6764005182&country=sg
